scope: Torneos gateway allowlist of the connected product (Torneos profile, Torneos inbox, catalog management, registration requests and the public catalog), added ONLY when TORNEOS_CONNECTED_MODE=on (connected.ts). `features`: RPCs of the authenticated generic route POST /torneos/rest/v1/rpc/<name> (verified bridge bearer + live Core session + local identity, exactly like the rest). `public`: RPCs of the anonymous read-only route POST /torneos/public/v1/rpc/<name>, served as the database role anon with a fixed, validated body (connected.ts CONNECTED_PUBLIC_PARAMS). list_my_core_teams_for_application, search_my_applicable_core_teams and start_tournament_application (with a Core team) go through the Core-contract adapter with the applicant authorizer (my_teams / directory_teams / team_snapshot). platform_remove_tournament_catalog_listing is deliberately absent (service_role only, no client). The database (00000000000009_connected_product_v1.sql) remains the final boundary. Source of truth: backend/torneos/connected-v1/contract.json.
